title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Scheduling Operations Agent optimises multiple resources at once
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, scheduling controls and consumption-based licensing are supported. Minor corrections should flag conflicting Microsoft guidance about exhausted credit capacity, cite the booking-status property reference and acknowledge the consumption-monitoring checklist step has no control row.

claims.claim: The Scheduling Operations Agent expands optimisation to multiple technicians in one request.
claims.quote: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources.
